name: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back against the wall and step your feet forward about hip-width apart.
Slide down until your thighs approach horizontal, with knees over ankles and both feet flat.
Brace your core lightly and rest your arms loosely at your sides or across your chest without pressing down on your thighs.
Hold the seated position steadily while breathing evenly for the target duration, then press smoothly back up the wall to stand.
tips: Keep your weight distributed evenly through your heels and midfoot rather than pushing onto your toes.
Do not rest your hands on your knees to take load off your quads.
